rationale: At the reported failure, the 0.6-wide AABB has Z extent18.4672–19.0672 and X extent18.3328–18.9328. It overlaps two floor voxels (18,19,18) and (18,19,19). The post-mining target is (18,18,18), consistent with the first floor cell being removed, but the neighboring floor voxel remains natural moss. The test incorrectly requires a fall after removing one of multiple supporting cells. Independently reconstructing the recorded coordinates and three reported mines keeps the player grounded when the neighboring support remains; removing the second support then causes a one-voxel fall. Do not weaken collision support rules to make this probe pass; center the body fully on the mined support or remove every intersecting support with normal input.

actual_next_action.description: Read failure coordinates, the probe input sequence and AABB floor collision traversal. Independently ran a synthetic canonical-model reconstruction at the exact recorded coordinates with the three mined cells and compared retained versus removed neighbor support. This is model evidence, not a replacement for ordinary-input rerun.
